metadata.title: Records and Retention

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing data retention, preservation, and lawful disposal as institutional obligations.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Records management systems, retention controls, legal hold mechanisms, and secure destruction processes.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for ensuring institutional data is retained, preserved, and disposed of in compliance with obligations.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Retention and records obligations depend on data classification and regulatory context.

metadata.remarks: Records and Retention defines trust properties required to identify institutional records, apply retention schedules, enforce legal holds, and ensure defensible destruction of data. These obligations apply independently of application or platform lifecycle.

components.title: Records Identification
components.description: Determines which data qualifies as an institutional record and under what conditions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Failure to identify data as a record to evade retention obligations.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement defining record status and applicability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Data is evaluated to determine whether it constitutes an institutional record.

components.title: Retention Schedules
components.description: Defines how long records and data must be retained.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Premature deletion of data to avoid legal or regulatory exposure.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle management enforcing minimum retention periods.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Retention schedules govern how long data and records are preserved.

components.title: Legal Holds and Preservation
components.description: Prevents deletion or alteration of data subject to legal or regulatory holds.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Destruction or modification of data under legal hold.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Preservation controls preventing alteration or deletion.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Legal holds prevent deletion or alteration of protected data.

components.title: Secure Destruction and Disposal
components.description: Ensures irreversible deletion of data at the end of its approved lifecycle.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Recovery of data that was improperly or incompletely destroyed.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Cryptographically or physically secure data destruction.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Data and records are securely destroyed when no longer required.

components.title: Audit and Attestation of Compliance
components.description: Provides evidence that retention and disposal obligations are met.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Lack of evidence to prove compliance with retention obligations.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging and attestation of records compliance.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Audit records demonstrate compliance with records retention requirements.
